headlines.title: Why Shopify (SHOP) Stock Is Up Today
headlines.summary: Shares of e-commerce platform Shopify (NASDAQ:SHOP) jumped 3% in the afternoon session after Cantor Fitzgerald increased its price target on the company to $158 from $145 while maintaining a Neutral rating.

headlines.title: Why Shopify Stock Popped by Nearly 5% Today
headlines.summary: A researcher tracking the company raised its price target.

headlines.title: Is It Too Late To Buy Shopify Stock?
headlines.summary: Shopify (SHOP) stock has risen 34.3% over the past three months, while the S&P 500 gained 2.8%. On September 22, the shares rose about 8% in early trading after Meta connected its Muse AI agent to Shopify's Shop Pay checkout. Investors buying the stock today pay for all of it. So how much does a buyer pay for Shopify's business after that rise.

headlines.title: Shopify Can Win Big With AI Agents. Why It May Take Time.
headlines.summary: Shopify rises after Deutsche Banks says the company is poised to win big from agentic commerce in the long run.

headlines.title: Shopify (SHOP): Building the Underlying Rails for the Era of Agentic Commerce
headlines.summary: Baillie Gifford & Co, an independent investment management firm, released its third-quarter 2026 investor letter for “US Equity Growth Strategy”. The letter can be downloaded here. While AI safety and human control concerns dominated recent industry discussions, the quarterly letter highlights the massive, untapped potential of deploying existing AI capacity into industrial applications.

description: Shopify Inc., a commerce technology company, provides tools to start, scale, market, and run a business of various sizes in Canada, the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia Pacific, and Latin America. The Company offers Shopify platform that enables merchants to manage products and inventory, process orders and payments, fulfill and ship orders, build customer relationships, source products, leverage analytics, and reporting and access financing for running their business across all of their sales channels, including web and mobile storefronts, physical retail locations, social media storefronts, and marketplaces. It also provides Shopify Payments, a fully integrated payment processing service that allows merchants to accept and process payment cards online and offline. In addition, the company engages in the sale of themes and apps; shipping labels through Shopify Shipping; point-of-sale hardware; advertising on the Shopify App Store; and Shop Campaigns for buyer acquisitions, as well as registration of domain names. The company was formerly known as Jaded Pixel Technologies Inc. and changed its name to Shopify Inc. in November 2011. Shopify Inc. was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Ottawa, Canada.
